rulesTestNames: lets managers get an organizer's audience sources and nothing else
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels CRM view triggers
read: current organizer managers get their organizer's view by id, as listOrganizerSavedAudiences admitted them (requireOrganizerManager); a view not written yet reads as missing; nobody lists the collection
write: server only; written from organizerForms, organizerApplicationForms, organizerFormVersions, events and organizerContactTagVocabularies
migrationNotes: Replaces the filterOptions of listOrganizerSavedAudiences for the Host app (#2306): the forms, filterable questions, events and manual tags exactly as the callable returned them. A source over the callable's bounds stores unavailableReason instead of options. The host-crm-views copy-forward migration creates views for organizers that predate the triggers.
No personal data: form titles, question labels, event names and the organizer's tag names.
